sources.entry: lz4 - Python bindings for the LZ4 fast compression library.

summary.one_liner: Python bindings for the LZ4 fast compression library, offering frame and block format compression with a standard-library-style API.
summary.what_it_does: The package wraps the LZ4 compression library for Python. Its production-ready bindings cover the LZ4 frame format, which the README recommends for interoperability, and the block format. The frame API mirrors the lzma, zlib, gzip and bz2 modules from the Python standard library, so it is intended as a drop-in replacement. It provides context managers and file handler support. Experimental bindings for the LZ4 streaming format are included but the README says they need further work. The bindings release the GIL during calls into the LZ4 library and are described as thread safe. The README says an extensive test suite is included and full documentation is built with Sphinx.
use_cases: read and write LZ4 compressed files
drop-in replacement for gzip or zlib in Python
compress blocks of data in multithreaded code
notable: Frame format bindings follow the API of Python's lzma, zlib, gzip and bz2 modules
Supports context managers and file handlers
Releases the GIL during LZ4 calls and is thread safe
Covers both LZ4 frame and block formats
caveats: Streaming format bindings are experimental and need further work
README gives no install or run instructions
